summary: Checkpoint large evidence pulls and repair crash-damaged publisher and watcher copies

replay.detail: No graph replay changes. Interrupted evidence pulls retain signed checkpoints and resume verification of the remaining refs.

schema.detail: No database or evidence log format changes. Existing signed log commits and copy refs remain readable.

rules.detail: Evidence trust and fast-forward publication requirements are preserved for every checkpoint.

compatibility.detail: Existing verifiers read checkpoint heads without changes. Empty publisher copies seed only from a trusted published head.

downtime.detail: No daemon downtime. Verification checkpoints after 500 refs or 120 seconds, and stamps each commit when made.

manual.detail: Update installed evidence-log-timer and evidence-log-watch scripts to enable fsync and watcher repair; the timer reads the publisher from main. Keep evidence GC paused until its separate fixes are installed.

recovery.detail: Publisher repair requires a trusted published continuation of the damaged local head and retains broken loose objects. An unpublished damaged head or untrusted remote alarms for operator recovery. Watcher repair retains its newest broken repository and preserves notification state. Reverting scripts restores previous behavior without converting stored data.
